generator.design: One fixed Gaussian-group realization; identical cells/noise/batch assignments across conditions; four exactly balanced batches within every group; tetrahedral additive shifts with half their energy inside and half outside the latent signal subspace

training: Unchanged Step4 v1 settings: 100 shuffled epochs, fresh independent reconstruction/joint branches, two complete passes, 32D latent, weight 0.1; baseline-only K per condition
evaluation: Unchanged full-dimensional exact-kNN primary 45-point grid, fixed 0.5, count-matched sensitivity, all rare cells
counterfactual_sensitivity: For each fitted transform, encode every cell under each of the four known shifts without refitting; average within-cell output variance across batches divided by output variance of the clean counterpart. Translation/rotation/global-scale invariant; degenerate denominator is undefined, never successful correction.
oracle_geometry: Mean 30-nonself-neighbor Jaccard with the exact no-batch-artifact input; clean-input baseline equals one. This includes cell-specific simulation noise and is a descriptive geometry check, not an established biological harm margin.

screen.preservation: Unchanged Step4 ARI/purity/rare-recall floors; report every seed/group and full grid
screen.correction: Affected condition only: positive mean reduction in counterfactual sensitivity and positive mean oracle-neighbor recovery, both positive in at least four of five training seeds; no preservation flags and no degenerate output
screen.clean: No correction benefit claim; report preservation flags and all geometry loss. Numerical batch mixing is descriptive because no artifact was added.
screen.scope: Descriptive conditional simulation screen, not significance, biological efficacy, or proof of generality

initial_gate: Full-budget mild seed 0 plus separate-process duplicate for each architecture; no selection by score; bitwise outputs/layout/weights/logs/counterfactuals and memory gate before remaining jobs
failure_policy: No automatic retries or seed replacement. Preserve failure and finish already-running siblings; cancel queued work.
stop_boundary: One simulation, three fixed strengths, thirty scientific training jobs plus two technical duplicates, ninety trained-stage and nine untrained-control evaluations. No tuning, other datasets, label repair or manuscript edits.
limitations: Single generator and data seed; algorithmic seeds are not independent datasets
No real biological or gene-expression simulation claim
Clean counterfactuals and simulated groups are evaluation-only oracle information
Raw-vector architecture, reconstruction units and effective loss balance differ from cartographic model
K is rederived from the observed unrefined condition, so the across-strength response includes this declared selection rule
